entry.note: FastAPI route GET /_nicegui/{version}/resources/{key}/{path:path}; the path parameter is request-controlled and may contain '..' segments

guards.note: filepath.resolve().relative_to(resources[key].path.resolve()) with HTTPException(403) on ValueError keeps the joined path inside the registered resource directory

sinks.note: FileResponse(filepath) on filepath = resources[key].path / path after only an exists() check

notes: Single-function flow (entry, guard and sink all in nicegui/nicegui.py::_get_resource). The resource base directory comes from dependencies.register_resource (called by Element.add_resource, e.g. the leaflet element) and is trusted; only the {path:path} URL segment is request-controlled. _get_library and _get_component are sibling route handlers unchanged by the fix; app, sio, Client (auto_index_client assignment), _lifespan, _startup and _shutdown are kept so every name the slice references is defined. Fix is complete for this route (both sides resolved before relative_to).
